programme.title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
programme.desc: Matt and Jay's plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, resulting in them accidentally travelling back to the year 2008.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

programme.title: The Deb
programme.desc: Two teenage cousins dig deep to find self-acceptance and a date to the Debutante Ball in a small country town in Australia.

programme.title: One Last Shot
programme.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defence network.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: When his wickedness is challenged, supervillain Gru hatches a plan to steal the moon. Enlisting three young orphans to help out, his dastardly plot is derailed when he begins to care for them.

programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: Just as a retired villain settles into his new role as a suburban family man, the ultra-secret Anti-Villain League sends him on a mission to nab the perpetrator of a spectacular heist.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. The siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who wants to take down the world.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female super-villain.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: With the evil wizard Gargamel hot on their trail, Smurfette, Brainy, Clumsy and Hefty embark on a journey through the Forbidden Forest to find a mysterious village.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
programme.desc: Hoping to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob follows a mysterious, swashbuckling ghost pirate known as the Flying Dutchman on a seafaring adventure that takes him to the deepest depths of the ocean.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life. From `Sing' to `The Bad Guys 2', enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: A pig, a mouse, a porcupine, a gorilla, an elephant and other animals gather at a koala's theatre for a singing competition.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

programme.title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
programme.desc: Mr Peabody, the most accomplished canine in the world, and his boy, Sherman, use a time machine called the Wabac to embark on outrageous adventures. However, when Sherman takes the Wabac without permission to impress his friend Penny, he accidentally rips a hole in the universe and causes havoc with world history. It's up to Mr Peabody to mount a rescue and prevent the past, present and future from being permanently altered. A DreamWorks animation.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Po might just be the laziest, clumsiest panda in the Valley of Peace, but he secretly dreams of becoming a kung fu legend. When the villainous snow leopard Tai Lung threatens Po's homeland, the hapless panda is chosen to fulfil an ancient prophecy and defend the Valley from attack. Training under Master Shifu, Po embarks on an epic high-kicking adventure as he sets out to thwart Tai Lung's evil plans. A DreamWorks animation.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: A panda must unlock the secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: After reuniting with his long-lost father, Po must train a village of clumsy pandas to help him defeat a supernatural warrior who becomes stronger with each battle.

programme.title: Fox and Hare Save the Forest
programme.desc: One day, Fox and Hare discover that Owl has disappeared. They go looking for him in the forest with all their friends and discover a big lake that wasn't there before. It is the beginning of an exciting and funny adventure.

programme.title: Flushed Away
programme.desc: A spoiled but lonely pet rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins, but his attempts to help escalate the conflict put them both in deadly danger.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Son of Memphis and Norma, little sweet penguin Mumble has a big problem: he can't sing a single note. In a world where everyone needs a heart song to attract a soul mate, Mumble feels he doesn't belong there. Our hero Mumble is the worst singer in the world, but he can tap dance brilliantly.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programme.desc: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

programme.title: Puss in Boots
programme.desc: Puss in Boots is run out of town on suspicion of bank robbery, even though the real villain is Humpty Dumpty. Though there is still animosity between them, they reunite to steal a goose that lays golden eggs.

programme.title: Charlie the Wonderdog
programme.desc: A dog gains superpowers after his owner is abducted by aliens. Together they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private are recruited by a secret organisation to help bring down an evil supervillain, Doctor Octavius Brine. He holds a grudge against the animals that stole the limelight from him.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Mr Fox plots one more raid on farmers Boggis, Bunce and Bean before he becomes a responsible father figure.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

programme.title: Grand Prix of Europe
programme.desc: Edda, a young mouse with big dreams, enters the Grand Prix disguised as her hero, Ed. She must outwit her rival's sabotage to prove that even the smallest racer can make the biggest impact.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets
programme.desc: A domesticated terrier and his unruly canine pal encounter a rebellious bunny and his gang of abandoned pets.

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
programme.desc: The film explores the bonds between pets and the families that love them, and answers the question: What are your pets doing when you’re not at home?

programme.title: Small Foot
programme.desc: Migo is a friendly Yeti who discovers something that he didn't know existed: a human. When his fellow villagers refuse to believe him, Migo embarks on an epic journey to find the mysterious creature that can put him back in good graces.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: As war with the Transformers rages on, inventor Cade Yeager forms an unlikely alliance with Bumblebee, an English lord and an Oxford professor to save the planet.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: The fate of humanity is at stake when two races of robots, the good Autobots and the villainous Decepticons, bring their war to Earth. The robots have the ability to change into different mechanical objects as they seek the key to ultimate power, but only human Sam Witwicky can save the world from total destruction.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Mikaela and Sam once again join forces with Optimus Prime again to save Earth from ruthless robot The Fallen.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: As humanity picks up the pieces after an epic battle, a shadowy group emerges to gain control of history. Meanwhile, a powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth.

The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbour Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.

programme.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.

programme.desc: Humanity faces extinction after a giant comet is discovered heading for Earth. As a desperate mission is launched to stop it, families, leaders and ordinary people confront fear, sacrifice and survival as the countdown begins.

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: Frustrated writer Jack Torrance takes a job as the winter caretaker at the ominous, mountain-locked Overlook Hotel so that he can write in peace. When he arrives there with his wife and son, they learn that the previous caretaker had gone mad. Slowly Jack becomes possessed by the evil, demonic presence in the hotel. Based on the book by Stephen King.

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Trapped
programme.desc: This edition of The Cinema List is about being trapped. From the depths of the ocean in '47 Meters Down' to the vastness of space in 'Gravity', getting out is easier said than done.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data, takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface.

programme.title: Escape From New York
programme.desc: Futuristic thriller set in Manhattan, which has become a maximum-security prison. When the US president is captured and held hostage by a ruthless gang, only one-eyed mercenary Snake Plissken is considered capable of effecting a rescue. If he fails, he is programmed to self-destruct.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Hilarity and horror ensue when toothy, carnivorous aliens escape from their space prison, pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. programme.desc: A kidnapped family and their two murderous captors confront bloodthirsty demons after crossing the Mexican border.

Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.

programme.desc: The curse of an ancient mummy protects buried treasure in the Egyptian desert. An American mercenary who knows of the secret location is rescued from a Cairo prison by an English historian and her brother, and together they set off on a hunt. Along the way, the trio encounter flesh-eating scarab beetles, killer sandstorms, and reincarnated demons.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: A lonely boy-ghost befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in an adventure.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Ever since her parents left her as a baby, little Annie has led a hard-knock life with her mean foster-mother, Miss Hannigan. However, that all changes when hard-nosed billionaire and mayor candidate Will Stacks takes her in on the recommendation of his advisers. Stacks believes that he's Annie's guardian angel, but the plucky youngster's confidence and sunny outlook may mean that Annie will save Will instead.

programme.desc: Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.
